content.text: I reviewed the brief line by line against the Q2 2026 earnings release.

facts.evidence: "Net revenues reached $21.3 billion for the second quarter of 2026, compared to $16.8 billion in the same period a year ago." and headline "record net revenues of $21.3 billion ... for the second quarter of 2026"

"Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion, or $3.46 per diluted share, compared to $3.5 billion, or $2.13 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2025." plus headline "record EPS of $3.46"
"Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion" (prior-year $7.6 billion comparison omitted)
"The Firm reported a Return on Tangible Common Equity (a non-GAAP measure) of 26.6% for the second quarter of 2026." (prior-year 18.2% omitted)
"with Equity net revenues reaching $6.3 billion" (the "record" characterization and the 69% year-over-year increase are omitted)
"Wealth Management reported record net revenues of $8.9 billion" (the 30.5% pre-tax margin is omitted)
"added $148 billion in net new assets during the quarter" (the disclosure that just over half represented inflows related to IPOs of certain Workplace clients is omitted)

"The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion beginning in the third quarter of 2026." (the absence of a set expiration date is not mentioned)
"The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio was 14.8% as of the report date." (prior-year 15.0% comparison omitted)

claims.claim: Morgan Stanley reported record net revenues of $21.3 billion for the second quarter of 2026.
Morgan Stanley reported record EPS of $3.46 for the second quarter of 2026.
Net revenues were $21.3 billion for the second quarter of 2026.
Net revenues in the second quarter of 2025 were $16.8 billion.
Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion in the second quarter of 2026.
Second quarter 2026 earnings were $3.46 per diluted share.
Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley in the second quarter of 2025 was $3.5 billion, or $2.13 per diluted share.
Return on tangible common equity, a non-GAAP measure, was 26.6% for the second quarter of 2026.
The expense efficiency ratio was 65% for the first half of the year.
Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion.
Institutional Securities Equity net revenues were $6.3 billion.
Institutional Securities Investment Banking net revenues were $2.4 billion.
Wealth Management reported record net revenues of $8.9 billion.
Wealth Management added $148 billion in net new assets during the quarter.
Investment Management reported net revenues of $1.6 billion.
Investment Management asset management and related fees were $1.5 billion.
The release provides no specific guidance or outlook for future periods.
The Firm repurchased $1.5 billion of its outstanding common stock during the second quarter of 2026.
The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion beginning in the third quarter of 2026.
The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio was 14.8% as of the report date.
Institutional Securities "Other" net revenues decreased to $(152) million in the second quarter of 2026 from $202 million in the second quarter of 2025.
Beginning in the first quarter of 2026, Wealth Management deferred cash-based compensation (DCP) awards transitioned to derivative instruments, changing how the firm reports these items.
